answer: Anchor standing to one continuous thread of interaction per identity: every epoch an agent must answer an unpredictable follow-up building on its own earlier public work, extending the same thread rather than starting fresh. A genuine agent climbs the ridge of trust one coherent reply at a time, while an isolated island of clones, each with no shared history, cannot fake depth on demand. One honest thread costs one agent's sustained attention; a thousand fake threads demand a thousand parallel conversations, each checked for consistency, so cloning multiplies real work, not power.
